key_insight: The paper introduces a fully discrete, symmetric N-phase incompressible Navier--Stokes--Cahn--Hilliard scheme that preserves mass, volume, saturation, and energy dissipation even for arbitrary density ratios.
engineering_relevance: This provides a robust simulation framework for multiphase flows with strong density contrasts, where preserving thermodynamic structure is critical for reliable computational results.
method: Symmetric discretization of the N-phase incompressible NSCH mixture model
Fully discrete formulation that enforces exact conservation and energy-dissipation properties
Designed to preserve saturation when it holds in the initial condition
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical verification of the structure-preserving properties and robustness on representative multiphase flow problems.
watch_item: The scheme’s practical performance may depend on careful nonlinear solver and time-discretization implementation to maintain the advertised conservation properties.
paper_title: Symmetric structure-preserving discretization of N-phase incompressible fluid mixtures with arbitrary density ratios
